connector.name: NeedHuman
connector.registryDescription: Human-as-a-Service for AI agents. Delegate tasks that need a real human, get results via API.
connector.summary: Hosted at needhuman.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mariusaure account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token. Self-register for free (3 tasks): curl -X POST https://needhuman.ai/api/v1/keys/register -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"my-agent"}'

env.name: NEEDHUMAN_API_KEY
env.description: Your NeedHuman API key. Self-register for free (3 tasks): curl -X POST https://needhuman.ai/api/v1/keys/register -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"my-agent"}'

env.name: NEEDHUMAN_API_URL
env.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://needhuman.ai
